ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “FOOD CHAIN.” It shows a flower labeled “FLOWER (Producer).” A caterpillar is shown on the plant and labeled “CATERPILLAR (Consumer).” The chain then continues with arrows from the caterpillar toward the frog, from the frog toward the snake, and from the snake toward the owl; the frog, snake, and owl are also labeled as consumers. Reasoning: A primary consumer is the organism that directly eats the producer. In this food chain, the flower is the producer, and the caterpillar is the first consumer associated with the flower/plant. Therefore, the primary consumer is the caterpillar.
